verdict.rationale: A runtime probe of the npm registry confirms three.js is MIT-licensed (threejs-probe-rt-1). MIT is a permissive license with no royalty or per-install fee terms, so a studio keeps its game revenue. missing for 10: first-party license documentation in the pack (e.g., the LICENSE file or a site statement), explicit evidence on commercial-use, royalty or attribution terms, and independent community corroboration of shipping commercial games.
